newsitem.title: INDIA: India's RBI to hold 14-day repos auction on Nov 8.
newsitem.headline: India's RBI to hold 14-day repos auction on Nov 8.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Wednesday it will conduct a 14-day repos auction of government securities on November 8.
The repos, of government of India dated securities, will be open to parties holding subsidiary general ledger account (SGL) and current account with the RBI at Bombay, the RBI said in a statement.
Bids for the auction will be accepted on November 8 upto 2.30 p.m and results announced the same evening, the RBI said.
Payment by successful bidders will be on November 9 up to 12.30 p.m, it said. The RBI will repurchase the securities on November 23, the statement said.
